readerCopy.body: Keeping everyone comfortable can become expensive when one person's body, sleep, meals, privacy, or time keeps absorbing the difference. When the Moon squares Lilith, care and autonomy create friction, making a familiar family or relationship routine harder to maintain without resentment. A need does not become selfish because another person dislikes the inconvenience it creates. The arrangement deserves to change before the body has to keep making the same argument through exhaustion or irritation.
